messages:
maya: Quick sync 1: comparing two options for Usage > Billing header layout. Option 1: legend stacked below chart, invoice CTA inline in the cost summary. Option 2: legend placed to the right of the chart, invoice CTA above the chart near totals. Which reduces cognitive load?

sam: Leaning Option 2. Right-side legend feels like a dashboard pattern users expect, fewer long scrolls.

aj: Dev constraints: right column is easy with CSS grid but must collapse gracefully. Mobile should revert to stacked.

leo: Accessibility reminder: visual placement != reading order. Keep DOM order: chart first, then legend, so screen readers narrate the graph before legend items. Also ensure legend items have clear text labels (no color-only cues).

sam: Plan: use grid with visual placement but keep DOM order. Example: 
```
.container { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 260px; gap: 20px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
```
This lets us keep SR order and compress on mobile.

olivia: From support: customers often ask "where's my invoice" after checking spend. Make invoice CTA discoverable. My recommendation: compact primary CTA in the totals area + a persistent top-level link in the header.

maya: I like that. Primary CTA near totals, secondary in header. Keep labels consistent.

sam: Color contrast: current purple/indigo pairs fail at small label sizes. I'll propose an updated palette and token swatches to meet AA.

leo: Please ensure legend text meets 4.5:1 contrast. Also add aria-describedby for token counts and role="list" semantics. If we make legend interactive (filter toggles) ensure keyboard focusable controls.

aj: API/tech note: prefer returning token totals as part of the usage endpoint so the legend can render without extra aggregation client-side. Avoid live re-aggregation on rerenders.

maya: Microcopy: olivia suggested we standardize: use "Download invoice" when action triggers a download, "View invoice" when rendering a preview. Can we add that into the style guide?

olivia: Yes. Also suggest adding a short helper text under the totals: "Invoice available for the selected billing period" when applicable.

sam: Mock uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc987  Please review spacing on the legend items.

design-bot: New mock bundle: https://redwood.design/mocks/1900460000-usage-billing :sparkles:

aj: I'll spin a small prototype with the grid approach and keep DOM ordering. Will add a tiny demo link.

leo: I'll draft an accessibility checklist for the PR: DOM order, aria labels, focus states, contrast, keyboard interactions, announcements for chart updates.

maya: Telemetry asks: track invoice_click, invoice_download, scope_toggle (org/project), legend_toggle. aj can we add these?

aj: Yep 1: will include events and a flag if users repeatedly toggle to project scope (could indicate we should default to project).

maya: UX animation: when switching Org vs Project, use a 150ms crossfade + slight y-offset to preserve context, not a hard jump. sam add that to animation spec.

sam: Will do, include easing curve and duration.

maya: Action items recap: sam 1: update color swatches + figma spacing + animation spec. aj: prototype grid demo + telemetry hooks. leo: accessibility checklist. olivia: microcopy snippets and support FAQ blurb. I'll open ticket RD-4028 and assign owners.

sam: Sounds good. Meeting to review prototype next Wed. Thanks all!
